candidates.description: In Experiment 1, Baron and Hershey (1988) found that participants rated medical decisions that resulted in positive outcomes higher than those that resulted in negative outcomes, despite the decisions being identical except for the outcome.
candidates.citation_sentence: We aimed to conduct a replication and extension of Experiment 1 from [2].
candidates.notes: Pre-registered replication and extension of Baron and Hershey (1988) Experiment 1, using a between-participants design with an online MTurk sample. The paper reports a successful replication of outcome bias with larger effect sizes than the original. Original main effect size for outcome type (success vs. failure) is not reported in the replication paper; original_es and related fields are left blank. Replication uses a between-participants design, a deviation from the original within-participants design.
